title: World-wide distributions of lactase persistence alleles and the complex effects of recombination and selection
authors: Liebert A, López S, Jones BL, Montalva N, Gerbault P, Lau W, et al.
funder: EU Marie Curie ITN FP7 Framework Programme grant LeCHE (215362-2); Bicentennial Becas-Chile Scholarship, Chilean National Commission for Scientific and Technological Research (CONICYT); Annals of Human Genetics; MRC-DTA studentship.
authorConflicts: No conflict of interest stated by the corresponding author on behalf of all authors.
result: Lactase persistence is associated with at least five independent functional single nucleotide variants in a transcriptional enhancer about 14 kb upstream of LCT: -13910*T (rs4988235), -13907*G (rs41525747), -13915*G (rs41380347), -14009*G (rs869051967) and -14010*C (rs145946881). -13910*T has almost reached fixation in some parts of Europe; the others occur at variable frequencies in the Middle East and Africa.
